summary: Reconcile replicated operation conflicts without a whole-log replay under the writer.

replay.detail: Operation digest conflicts update the deterministic registry and refold only affected subject projections, with a 4096-claim bound. Conflicts never trigger receipt-time full replay, including when another projection guard requests fallback. Graph semantics still fold all admitted claims in canonical order.

schema.detail: No persistent schema or wire-format changes; conflict and degraded diagnostics use existing projection_health rows.

rules.detail: Claim admission, canonical claim ordering, retention and operation selection rules are unchanged. Operation rows use the existing minimum-digest/smallest-retained-claim reducer.

compatibility.detail: Updated receivers retain typed operation-conflict diagnostics in existing projection-failure detail and store health instead of silently entering a full replay. Older binaries can still replay on a conflicting receipt. Writer-hold JSON adds optional processed and total fold counters.

manual.detail: Large affected histories and projection families without a subject reducer remain explicitly degraded; receipt does not repair them automatically. Separately committed repair pages are required before these diagnostics can be cleared.

recovery.detail: An above-cap or failed affected-subject refold rolls back that refold and retains the prior projection, with operation and claim identifiers. A conflict also fences full-replay fallback requested by another guard. No resumable large-history repair is introduced in this change.

downtime.detail: Ordinary forward binary restart; no measured production writer-hold improvement is claimed.
